text:
jess_peopleops: Heads-up for Monday onboarding for Sam_newhire. Need confirmation on I-9 verification method, BG vendor status, laptop handoff time, escort, and a short 30m HR intro. Who can claim tasks?

mohit_hr: I can do I-9 & background. GoodHire started intake but theres one missing reference form. For the I-9 we prefer in-person verification on day one; authorized verifier list attached in the checklist.

li_it: Ill prepare a laptop image and set up accounts. Do we do onsite pickup or desk drop? We typically stage devices for pickup at the IT desk. If onsite pickup, plan 10-15 minutes for MDM and MFA.

sam_newhire: Im coming into the SF office; pickup is fine. Quick note: mailing address is my home, but not needed. Also my SS card is currently in a wallet, is a photo okay for pre-check?

mohit_hr: A clear photo of the SS card and DL uploaded to the portal is fine for pre-screen. Bring originals on Day 1 for I-9. If passport renewal finishes later we can re-verify, no problem.

jess_peopleops: facilities_bot / security can you schedule an escort for 09:20 and reserve Desk 12? Also need a badge on arrival and a parking permit if possible.

security: Badge will be printed. Escort assigned for 09:20. Bring a government or state photo ID for pickup; well match it to the I-9 docs.

facilities_bot: Desk 12 reserved. Parking pass added to Sam_newhire profile for Monday.

li_it: Ive queued the staging job: `./provision --user samn --profile onboarding-standard`. ETA: asset ready by Friday COB. Will send MDM invite to the new hire email.

mohit_hr: Background status: awaiting reference check completion, vendor SLA says 48-72h after references. Ill escalate if not green by Friday.

sam_newhire: Uploaded DL and SS photo to the portal just now. Lunch preferences: no beef, vegan ok.

jess_peopleops: Great. Plan for Day 1: 09:15 lobby meet, 09:20 badge + desk, 09:40 IT pairing (MFA/dev tools), 10:15 HR intro (benefits overview), 11:00 team welcome. Ill order lunch (send any allergies).

li_it: Confirmed laptop imaged and labeled SAMN-ONB-2027. MDM invite sent at 16:03.

mohit_hr: Reference check completed  marked clear. BG final status: Clear. I-9 can proceed Mon in-person.

sam_newhire: Thanks everyone, see you Monday.

jess_peopleops: Closing thread  if any last-minute changes ping @jess_peopleops here. :party:
